why: The short line (corner to centre) moves one corner clockwise each time: top-left, top-right, bottom-right, so next is bottom-left. The long diagonal switches direction every time, so next it must go from top-left to bottom-right. Option 1 has both. Options 2, 3 and 4 repeat earlier figures.
trick: When two lines are inside a square, follow each line on its own.
